questions.title: Which Russian official will the Kremlin publicly confirm as attending Ali Khamenei's state funeral?
questions.background: Iran's supreme leader Ali Khamenei was killed on February 28, 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Russian official whose planned attendance at Ali Khamenei's state funeral is publicly confirmed by the Kremlin. Use the Kremlin's announcement or reliable reporting of it. This question concerns the announcement, not actual attendance.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-02
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the official's full name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the official's full name.

questions.title: Which Gaza locality will be the site of the deadliest Israeli strike reported on July 17, 2026?
questions.background: A ceasefire between Israel and Hamas took effect in October 2025, but Israeli attacks in Gaza have continued.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Al Jazeera's July 17, 2026 reporting on that day's attacks across Gaza. Compare individual strikes rather than cumulative deaths across separate attacks.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Resolve to the city, town, or refugee camp where the individual Israeli strike with the highest reported death toll occurred. Answer with the locality's name.
questions.accepted_format: Resolve to the city, town, or refugee camp where the individual Israeli strike with the highest reported death toll occurred. Answer with the locality's name.

questions.title: Who will be appointed head of Syria’s National Security Bureau in July 2026?
questions.background: The National Security Bureau oversees Syria’s security agencies.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Syrian government announcement or reporting by the Syrian state news agency SANA identifying the person appointed head of the National Security Bureau during July 2026.
  • Resolution Date: The date the appointment is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointee’s full name.

questions.title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
questions.background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-03
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.

questions.title: In which country outside Iran, if any, will US forces strike Iran-aligned armed groups between July 22 and July 29, 2026?
questions.background: Iran-aligned armed groups operate across several Middle Eastern countries, creating potential flashpoints for military confrontation with the United States.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera, supported where available by official military statements.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the country outside Iran where US forces conduct strikes against Iran-aligned armed groups between July 22 and July 29, 2026, inclusive. Direct US participation in either unilateral or joint strikes qualifies; threats, proposed operations, and diplomatic support do not.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name, or “None” if no qualifying strikes occur.
questions.accepted_format: The country's name, or “None” if no qualifying strikes occur.

questions.title: Which country will announce a new multinational maritime coalition to protect navigation through the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Gulf of Aden by August 1, 2026?
questions.background: Attacks on commercial shipping since 2023 have heightened concerns about the security of maritime trade routes through the Red Sea.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the country that announces the creation of a new multinational maritime coalition between July 1 and August 1, 2026, inclusive, with a stated purpose of protecting freedom of navigation through the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Gulf of Aden. Joining an existing coalition does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.

questions.title: Which university will house Raja Shehadeh's personal diary archive by August 31, 2026?
questions.background: Raja Shehadeh is a Palestinian writer and lawyer who has kept personal diaries since 1967.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the university confirmed to be physically holding Shehadeh's original personal diary archive by August 31, 2026. Confirmation must come from public statements by Shehadeh or the receiving university, or contemporaneous news reporting establishing that the archive has arrived, rather than merely announcing a planned transfer.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-31
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (institution). Answer with the university's name.
questions.accepted_format: string (institution). Answer with the university's name.

questions.title: Which country will agree to a joint project with Iran to clear sea mines from the Strait of Hormuz by August 26, 2026?
questions.background: Sea mines have been reported near the Strait of Hormuz, a major route for international oil and gas shipments.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country that agrees with Iran to a joint mine-clearance project in the Strait of Hormuz, as announced in a statement from the two governments by August 26, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-26
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: From which UK city will the aid boat Kate depart on its Gaza mission in August 2026?
questions.background: The Freedom Flotilla organizes sea voyages aimed at delivering aid to Gaza and challenging Israel's blockade.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the UK city from which Kate sets sail in August 2026 as part of a Freedom Flotilla effort to reach Gaza, according to contemporaneous reporting of its departure.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the city name.

questions.title: Which country will become the second, after the United States, to formally recognise Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights by the end of 2026?
questions.background: The United States formally recognised Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights in 2019. Most of the international community has rejected Israel’s annexation of the territory.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first country other than the United States whose national government publicly announces formal recognition of Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights between January 1 and December 31, 2026. Support for Israeli security interests without explicit recognition of sovereignty does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.

questions.title: Which Israeli company will Save the Children Norway urge Norway's sovereign wealth fund to divest from by September 20, 2026?
questions.background: Norway's sovereign wealth fund reduced its holdings in Israeli companies in 2025, citing the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Israeli company publicly identified by Save the Children Norway or its representatives as a divestment target over concerns that its products could contribute to violations of international humanitarian law. Use statements or contemporaneous reporting published between January 1 and September 20, 2026. Answer with the company's full name.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-20
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (company)
